page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Faint marks at bottom right, not transcribed.

main_text.p: pessiones mihi. sunt propriis meis longè accep-biores.

Hoc vero Tibi in prudentiam ultra alios Principes accessit, quòd annos aliquot ætatis tuæ maturescentis in patientiæ exercitio & duris temporibus exegisti, sub quibus Pietas non minus quàm Virtutes cæteræ Morales & Politicæ (velut furculi in hyeme sati) fœliciùs fere succrefcunt, quàm in calore & serenitate meliorum temporum, vel inter illa voluptatum blandimenta, quæ in Pace & rerum affluentia Aulis Principum nimis hærent, quæque omnem Veræ Virtutis & Honoris her-bam vel stirpitùs evellunt, vel sat habent Frondibus earum & marcescenti specie ornari, nullo fructu in publicum ,l[?] in quod utinam serió cogitarent Principes se & natos maximè & à Deo destinatos.

Jam, quæ vis sit diversæ educationis Sacra Pagina ostendit in exemplis Davidis & Rchoboam[?], quorum alterum multæ ærumnæ in florentissimum Regnum præpararunt, hic Aulæ Salomonis sœlicitate nimiâ emollitus est; atque adeo cum grandi detrimento Honoris & Pacis, tum ipsius etiam Regni mutilatione, corruptus ab eorum adulationibus, qui (non secus ac muscæ æstivis fructibus) rebus Principum fecundis indivulsè hærent, dum adversis tandem ut hyeme abigantur.
Te vero magis exopto Carolo illi Bono quam Grandi similem: Deum spero utrumque effecturum, cùm in Te dona collata & Gra-tias

page.notes: Faint show-through marks along the left edge and scattered in the right margin are not printed text and are omitted. Bottom right has faint marks ("-Ω-" and a small line below) that I could not confirm as printed text, so they are left out. The Greek running head is read from a small, worn header; the letters may differ slightly from the form shown. "Rchoboam" is probably "Rehoboam" with a damaged e, so I marked it [?]. The sequence ",l" after "publicum" is unclear and marked [?].
